name: Dust word
what: One big word turns to grain - its edge breaks up, the grains scatter and thin out - then gathers back; or forms out of dust; or blows away sideways; small words frame it at the corners.

learned_from.what: the big word breaking into dust and coming back, small words around it

motion: dissolves 30 f (the threshold falls, the scatter grows), back 30 f (slow end); a slow push-in
